evidence_excerpts: Alerting was indexed by subtracting performance measures on double-cue trials from those on no-cue trials; orienting by subtracting spatial-cue trials from center-cue trials; and conflict monitoring by subtracting congruent target trials from incongruent target trials.
text: The Attention Network Test separates alerting, orienting, and conflict monitoring by subtracting performance across predefined cue and target conditions.
